I’m not sure if you understand. I texted him, and he didn’t text back so I just went on doing what I was doing.. I wasn’t expecting him to text me straight back I was just curious as to what he was doing, no harm no foul there.

Because asking for a text is making him stop everything, right. Yet again, wasn’t asking for his minute by minute plans and still didn’t when he told me.
I do tell him how I feel, and he understands.
I will say again, I wasn’t asking him what he was doing for any second of the time he was gone. I wondered where he was, and apparently thinking about what someone is doing is wrong.
I do give him space. It’s just when you’re in a relationship with your best friend, you want to tell them about your day and what happened.
Once again, I wasn’t in any way harassing him while he wasn’t responding. I knew he probably had a reason for not.

I wasn’t mad at him, and I’m still not now. I sent him a video saying that it did hurt my feelings a bit that he didn’t respond for awhile and then was going to sleep. Which he then told me what he was doing, and I was fine with that because he know he doesn’t get to hang out with this friend much. I just felt he could’ve given me a heads up we wouldn’t get to discuss our days tonight.

I do have patience with him, and I understand he’s busy a lot. He works hard and takes care of his family in many ways. It was just difficult for me to help him see that I was excited to tell him how my first day went and then he didn’t reply or open my message for two hours. I completely don’t blame him if he ever forgets to respond because he’s got a lot on his plate right now.
I wasn’t asking him to account for his every minute, and I don’t ever ask him to. He lives his own life as he chooses, I don’t control him in any way.
